name: weak-shell
notes: Weak shells whose competitive form is elite, mixed with ordinary early mons at cap 25. Magikarp (Gyarados at 20) and Tyrogue (Hitmonlee at 20) genuinely evolve in time, so they are honest picks; Feebas (Milotic needs beauty/trade — not reachable) and Igglybuff (a friendship baby whose next form is still passive) must not ride their lines' fame onto the team.
